arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Karlan argued statutory interpretation is a holistic process.
Ms. McKiever argued two requirements must be met for exemption.
Justice Scalia questioned if tax benefits trigger age-based restrictions.
Justice Ginsburg noted the funds were shielded while in the plan.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the scope of bankruptcy exemptions for retirement funds. It determines whether debtors retain tax-advantaged assets during financial distress. Creditors rely on these funds to satisfy debts. The outcome shapes national bankruptcy policy.
